title: Positive feedback as calibration, not as decoration

videos.script: Paula writes the summary of an incident for the clinics. It is very good. {{title}} Renata's first instinct is a message in the channel. Great write-up, Paula. {{channel}} It is sincere, and it tells Paula nothing. Great in what way? Compared with what? For whom? {{questions}} So Renata says it differently. You led with what the clinics experienced, and put the cause last. Two owners replied, and nobody asked a question. {{specific}} Now Paula knows what to do again. And the team learns what good looks like here. {{calibrate}} This lesson is about praise that teaches. Why the famous ratio was withdrawn. Why the feedback sandwich stops working. {{sandwich}} And when to praise in public, and how to give the credit to the right person. {{credit}}
